title: Service Deployment
description: Configuration for deploying a backend service.

name.description: Unique identifier for the deployed service.

enabled.description: Whether the service receives live traffic.

port.description: TCP port the service listens on.

path.description: Endpoint path checked by the load balancer.

intervalSeconds.description: Delay between readiness checks in seconds.

labels.description: Key-value metadata attached to the deployment.
